## Task 2:

```{r}
count_above <- function(num_vec , cut_off) { #this is defining the function
  count <- 0 #this is the starting of the count value
  for (i in 1:length(num_vec)) { #this is where we state the for loop 
    if (num_vec[i] > cut_off) { #this is where we tell that if the num_vec is greater return how many values are indeed greater
      count <- count + 1 #this is where the it counts the number of ones greater
    }
  }
  return(count) #This returns the count value
}

count_above(1:31, 15) #this is where we assign num_vec and the cut off values
```

```{r}
count_above <- function(num_vec , cut_off) {
  count <- 0
  for (i in 1:length(num_vec)) {
    if (num_vec[i] > cut_off) {
      count <- count + 1
    }
  }
  return(count)
}

count_above(iris$Sepal.Length, 6)
```
